content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Automate the Allocation Creation for Event Checkout ## slug: automate-allocation-creation-event-checkout ## seoTitle: Automate the Allocation Creation for Event Checkout ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End You can automate the {{variable.Object_Allocation}} creation for {{variable.Object_Event}} checkouts. 1. Navigate to Blackthorn | Payment Trigger Settings (Setup > Custom Settings). ![H_01_01_Automate 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_01_Automate%201.png){height="" width=""} 2. Click **Manage**. ![H_01_01_Automate 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_01_Automate%202.png){height="" width=""} 3. Set the {{variable.Field_CS_AutoCreateAllocation}} = {{variable.Checkbox_True}}. ![H_01_01_Automate 3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_01_Automate%203.png){height="" width=""} 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. When this setting is enabled and an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} is created by the checkout process, the {{variable.Object_Allocation}}s are automatically created for the {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s and {{variable.Object_Invoice}}.
procedures: 1. Navigate to Blackthorn | Payment Trigger Settings (Setup > Custom Settings)
